entries.description: Point-in-time SEC XBRL facts captured by capital.sec
SEC 8-K Item 2.02 releases and periodic filings

Q3 2026 earnings release: condensed income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, segment and regional metrics, non-GAAP reconciliations, 2026 outlook including and excluding Intermex (8-K Exhibit 99.1, accession 0001193125-26-447234, filed 2026-11-04)

Q3 2026 Form 10-Q: borrowings and maturities, commercial paper, term loans, dividends and repurchases, Beyond efficiency program costs, Intermex merger status (accession 0001193125-26-447662, filed 2026-11-04)
8-K Item 8.01: second HSR waiting period for the Intermex merger expired 2026-11-02; merger still needs reinstated California DFPI approval (accession 0001193125-26-444420)

8-K Items 1.02, 7.01, 8.01: Western Union terminated the Intermex merger agreement under the November 10 outside date after DFPI's final conditions; no termination fee; Intermex's counsel called the notice invalid and threatened suit (accession 0001193125-26-457046, filed 2026-11-12)
Press release of 2026-11-10 announcing the Intermex termination and the DFPI approval history (8-K Exhibit 99.1, accession 0001193125-26-457046)

8-K Items 1.02, 2.03: $800M drawn on 2026-11-10 under the January 2026 delayed-draw term loan to repay the $800M 2024 term loan due December 2027 on about 2026-11-17 (accession 0001193125-26-461028, filed 2026-11-13)

StockAnalysis forecast page (S&P Global Market Intelligence, TipRanks; last updated 2026-11-13): 18 analysts, Sell consensus, mean target $6.73 ($6.00-$8.50, median $6.50), FY2026 EPS $1.32 and revenue $4.00B, FY2027 EPS $1.46 and revenue $4.11B; recent target actions; shows 2026-11-24 close $6.22
StockAnalysis statistics page (S&P Global, updated 2026-11-24): market cap $1.94B, EV $3.73B, short interest 60.21M shares (19.30% of shares out), beta 0.58, dividend $0.94 (15.11% yield)

Text of the Q3 2026 earnings presentation (pdftotext; the 5 MB PDF is not kept): Beyond efficiency actions (650+ headcount reduction, Costa Rica to Guatemala move by end-2027), YTD cash flow, gross leverage 3.3x and net 2.0x, 2026 outlook

drillr.ai structured summary of the Q3 2026 call: EPS $0.42 vs $0.34 consensus and revenue $1.01B vs $1.02B (earnings calendar feed); Saudi partner account-payout exit (about half of Q3 Branded Digital growth); 2026 capex about $190M; ahead of $50M run-rate savings by year-end; buybacks paused for the 2.5-3.0x leverage target

Web excerpts captured 2026-11-24: Intermex's Delaware Chancery suit (GlobeNewswire 2026-11-24, Payments Dive), Intermex's 2026-11-11 rejection, Longbridge weekly recap, CFO remarks on Beyond savings and the Q3 beat
